grades.description: Painkiller: slow Health regeneration in combat.
Adrenaline Rush 1: more maximum Health.
Speed Junkie + Comeback Kid: stronger regeneration while moving or wounded.
Adrenaline Rush 2: boost all Health regeneration sources.
Adrenaline Rush 3: Blood Pump and Health Items can grant Adrenaline.
Dorph-head: mitigation after Blood Pump or a Health Item.
Army of One: regeneration improves near enemies.
Calm Mind + Bloodlust: delay Adrenaline decay and gain Adrenaline from nearby dismemberments.
Juggernaut: move faster and deal more damage during Adrenaline Rush.
Unstoppable Force: ignore movement penalties and non-damaging status effects during Adrenaline Rush.
Pain to Gain: neutralizations during Adrenaline Rush recharge Health Items.
Die! Die! Die! 1: Stamina regeneration.
Die! Die! Die! 2: handling improves as Stamina falls.
Bullet Ballet + Like a Feather: mobile firing and weapon movement.
Spontaneous Obliteration 1: Crit Chance rises as Stamina falls.
Spontaneous Obliteration 3: unlock Obliterate on weakened enemies.
Spontaneous Obliteration 2 + Don't Stop Me Now: close-range damage and defense at low Stamina.
Rush of Blood: faster reload after dismemberment.
Skullcracker: stronger Quick Melee at low Stamina.
Dread: ranged attacks reduce enemy Armor; dismemberment spreads it.
Close-quarters Carnage: more ranged Obliterate chance up close.
Rip and Tear + Onslaught: shotgun/Quick Melee damage loop or LMG ammo refill on neutralization.
Wrecking Ball 1: lower blunt-attack Stamina cost.
Wrecking Ball 2: sprint-block charge that can knock enemies down.
Fly Swatter + Kinetic Absorption: ranged blocking defense and Stamina/damage from blocks.
Clapback: stronger knockdown and stun counterattacks.
Quake 3: ground or midair slam.
Quake 1 + Quake 2: lower blunt Stamina cost and faster blunt attacks.
Breakthrough: strong attacks lower enemy Armor.
Aftershock: regain Stamina per enemy hit by Quake.
Epicenter: midair Quake scales with fall speed and distance.
Ripple Effect: gain Health per enemy hit by Quake.
Finisher: Savage Sling: finish or throw a weakened enemy.
Slippery: faster movement makes you harder to hit.
Dash 2: unlock Dash.
Dash 1 + Power Slide: cheaper Dash/dodge and longer slides.
Muscle Memory + Parkour!: reload while moving and vault or climb faster.
Air Dash 3: unlock midair Dash.
Air Dash 1 + Air Dash 2: cheaper and faster Dashes.
Can't Touch This + Mean Streak: mitigation during Dash and longer Dashes toward enemies.
Steady Grip + Multitasker: fire during Dash and other movement actions.
Aerial Acrobat + Aerodynamic: midair control and mitigation.
Mad Dash: Stamina after a neutralization while Dashing.
Tailwind: Air Dashes cost no Stamina and restore it.
Ready, Rested, Reloaded 1: cheaper AR/SMG shooting.
Ready, Rested, Reloaded 2: faster reload at high Stamina.
Spice of Life + Mind Over Matter: faster swaps, less spread, less aimed recoil.
Sharpshooter 1: faster aim.
Sharpshooter 3: successful shots build Sharpshooter stacks.
Sharpshooter 2 + Practice Makes Perfect: handling and Crit bonuses as stacks build.
Tunnel Vision + Gundancer: effective range, mobile aiming, and vault shooting.
Spray and Pray + Air Kerenzikov: cheaper hip-fire and a midair Kerenzikov option.
Shoot to Chill: Armor penetration per Sharpshooter stack.
Submachine Fun: SMG swaps auto-reload and briefly improve fire rate.
Salt in the Wound: consecutive shots on the same target trigger bonus damage.
Lead and Steel 1: cheaper blade attacks.
Lead and Steel 2: block projectiles with a Blade.
Bullet Deflect + Seeing Double: aimed deflections and stronger counterattacks.
Bullet Time: enhanced deflections while time is slowed.
Finisher: Bladerunner 3: unlock Blade Finisher.
Finisher: Bladerunner 1 + 2: cheaper and faster Blade attacks.
Flash and Thunderclap: leap toward enemies on Strong Attacks.
Opportunist: more enemies become susceptible to Finishers.
Going the Distance: longer Finisher reach.
Flash of Steel: speed after a Finisher.
Slaughterhouse: attacks and deflections apply Bleeding to set up Finishers.
All Things Cyber 1: stronger cyberware stat modifiers.
All Things Cyber 2: lower Capacity cost for Integumentary and Skeleton cyberware.
Driver Update + Lucky Day: extra cyberware modifier and more looted components.
License to Chrome 1: further cyberware stat modifiers.
License to Chrome 3: additional Skeleton slot and Skeleton stat boost.
License to Chrome 2 + Extended Warranty: Armor and longer cyberware effects.
**Custom:** Chrome Calibration: +4 Cyberware Capacity. (Ambidextrous, the extra Hands slot, moved to the Hands Expansion shard.)
Built Different: unlock and support Cellular Adapter.
Renaissance Punk + Chipware Connoisseur: skill-derived Capacity and cyberware upgrade choices.
Chrome Constitution + Cyborg: rewards for filled cyberware slots.
Edgerunner: exceed Capacity at a Health cost.
Glutton for War: extra Health Item charge and recharge.
Health Freak 1 + First Aid: faster item and grenade recharge.
Health Freak 2 + Transfusion: recharge on neutralization and stronger final Health Item charge.
Demolitions Surplus + Coming in Hot: more grenade supply and recharge.
Pyromania 3: explosion hits build Pyromania movement/damage stacks.
Pyromania 1 + 2: recharge and explosion-radius bonuses.
Friendlier Fire + Doomlauncher: resist your own explosions; grenade perks also help Projectile Launch System.
Borrowed Time + Field Medic: emergency item recovery and faster combat use.
Heat Shield + Burn This City: stack-based mitigation and grenade replenishment.
Flash Sale: greater Flash, Smoke, and Recon grenade supply.
Ticking Time Bomb: delayed EMP on Operating System or Overclock activation.
Bolt 1: faster Tech-weapon charging.
Bolt 2: more charged-shot damage.
In Charge: holding full charge no longer auto-fires.
**Custom:** damaging fully charged Tech shots restore 2 Stamina.
Bolt 3: unlock timed Bolt shots.
Internal Clock: wider timing window for a Bolt.
Shock Value: Bolt shots ignore Armor.
Lightning Storm: repeated Bolts accelerate charging.
**Custom:** Tech weapons gain 5% headshot damage while this grade is active.
**Custom:** a fully charged Tech-shot neutralization restores 5 Stamina.
Chain Lightning: Bolt deals Electrical damage and arcs to nearby enemies.
Optimization: RAM recovery.
Embedded Exploit 1 + Encryption: RAM recovery and lower traceability.
Embedded Exploit 2 + Proximate Propagation: damage on prepared targets and cheaper close-range hacks.
ICEpick + Subordination: prepared Combat hacks cost less; Control hacks last longer.
Overclock 3: spend Health to quickhack without enough RAM.
Overclock 1 + 2: RAM recovery and quickhack damage.
Speculation + System Overwhelm: RAM refund on Combat-hack neutralizations and damage from layered effects.
Shadowrunner + Blood Daemon: Takedowns reduce trace; queued hacks on an Overclock victim restore Health.
Race Against Mind + Power Surge: low-Health damage and Health on Overclock activation.
Sublimation: RAM recovery also regenerates Health during Overclock.
Spillover: hacks can spread during Overclock.
Hack Queue 2: unlock ordered quickhack queues.
Hack Queue 1 + Eye in the Sky: Max RAM and camera/Access Point utility.
Data Recycler + Feedback Loop: refund unused queued hacks and recover RAM while queuing.
Queue Prioritization: faster upload at the start of a populated queue.
Queue Acceleration 3: larger, faster late queue.
Queue Acceleration 1 + 2: Max RAM and cheaper device/vehicle hacks.
Warning: Explosion Hazard + ForceKill Cypher: device explosion and Access Point bonuses.
Copy-Paste + Counter-a-hack: counter hostile netrunners and spread a counterhack.
Siphon: Monowire attacks restore RAM.
Finisher: Live Wire: Monowire Finisher improves with queued hacks.
Queue Mastery: larger queue and a powerful final-slot reward.
Acquisition Specialist 1: larger Smart-weapon targeting area.
Acquisition Specialist 2: keep locks on reload and lock faster.
No Escape: shooting a target can renew a fading lock.
Precision Subroutines: accuracy scales with Max RAM; **custom fallback:** small flat accuracy bonus without a cyberdeck.
Target Lock Transfer 2: keep head/weakspot lock between aiming and hip-fire.
Target Lock Transfer 1: further enlarge the target area.
Target Lock Transfer 3: keep locks when swapping Smart weapons.
Recirculation: RAM after Smart-weapon neutralization; **custom:** Smart-weapon neutralizations also restore 5 Stamina.
Terminal Velocity: Smart-weapon neutralizations improve projectile speed and range.
Smart Synergy: instant lock and bonus damage during Overclock; **custom:** a small passive lock-speed bonus.
Targeting Prism: lock multiple targets while aiming.
Feline Footwork: faster, safer crouched movement.
Ninjutsu 1: crouch movement speed.
Unexposed: mitigation while aiming from cover.
Ninjutsu 2: mitigation while crouched.
Ninjutsu 3: unlock crouch-sprinting.
Small Target: mitigation while crouched and still.
Blind Spot: crouched mitigation delays detection.
Serpentine: mitigation while crouch-sprinting.
Shinobi Sprint: cheaper crouch-sprinting in combat.
Vanishing Act: Optical Camo activates while crouch-sprinting or sliding.
Creeping Death: stealth neutralizations restore Health/Stamina and grant speed.
Killer Instinct: stronger knives, axes, and silenced guns outside combat.
Scorpion Sting 1 + Gag Order: faster throwable recovery and delayed group detection.
Scorpion Sting 2 + Corrosion: precision throws apply Poison, including to machines.
Neurotoxin + Accelerated Toxin Absorption: control Poisoned enemies and cash out Poison with a hit.
Juggler 3: qualifying thrown neutralizations reset throwable cooldowns.
Juggler 1 + 2: faster recovery and more precision damage.
Parasite + Quick Getaway: thrown precision hits heal; stealth neutralizations grant speed.
Pay It Forward + Sleight of Hand: reward retrieved throws and Juggler activation.
Finisher: Act of Mercy: Throwable Weapon Finisher.
Pounce: longer Finisher reach after a thrown hit.
Style Over Substance: guaranteed thrown Crits during skilled movement.
